title: A report opened again from the menu starts on today's date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to the 1st of last month.
  4. Click "Inventory Value" in the left list.
  5. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  6. Read the date chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 6:

  • the date chip shows today's date, not the 1st of last month.

Why this matters: Every visit starts from today's position; nothing stale is carried over.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/composables/useReportFilters.ts:245; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:176-182. V1 code, quoted: `persistFiltersToAccount = false,`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-016) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
